text_block_list.text:
It was when preparations for the Japan Cup
were finally reaching their final stages.
While heading to the academy in the morning...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: *gasp*, *pant*, *pant*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Haa... whew, whew...

From the looks of it, she's doing some pretty grueling training.
She's been at it since early morning—just how much has she run?

"...If I recall correctly, Cheval Grand
had also declared her entry into
the Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Not yet.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
More, more, I have to...
I have to become able to hold on even more.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Hold on... hang in there...
I'll push past them and win, no matter what—!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Oh no, the time...!
I won't make it before class starts...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I... I have to hurry...!

Later that afternoon, in the Trainer's Office. We were
scheduled to have our final meeting regarding the strategy
for the day of the Japan Cup, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Now then, there are various agenda items, but first—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The rival we must watch out for the most in this race...
We should probably discuss Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Her run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) was quite impressive, but the longer the distance, the more terrifying she becomes with that monstrous stamina of hers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"The Japan Cup adds 400 meters to the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
How should we conquer the long Tokyo Racecourse stretch and the final war of attrition... We need a strategy."
choice_data_list: You're right. ...I'd like to talk about that too, but—
Yeah. ...I wanted to talk about that too, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ? ...What's the matter?
choice_data_list: Before that, there's one thing I want you to hear.

text_block_list.text:
Yes, and saying so—instead of Kitasan Black,
I spread out the materials for another Umamusume.

"What comes to mind is how she looked this morning.
...That sheer aura. That tenacity."

Radiating brilliantly from her very being—
was a powerful will yearning for victory.
choice_data_list: There's a dark horse we need to be extremely wary of this time.
There is a dark horse this time that we must be most wary of.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Is this document―

She seems to have understood at a single glance.
I nod toward her, clever as always.
Aside from the favorite, Kitasan Black—
choice_data_list: Come up with a strategy that also counters Cheval Grand

text_block_list.text:
With her eyes opened wide,
Satono Crown remained silent for a while.

"It seemed to be such an unexpected proposal,
or so it thought—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I'm sorry.
I was surprised, but not in the way you think.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Because—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hey, I was the one who was going to say that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm of the exact same mind.
Well then, that settles it quickly!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Shall we get started right away?
The "Cheval Grand Countermeasure Strategy Meeting"!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Cheval!
Zouchen!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Jo... ah, uh, umm.
Good morning...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh. Did you learn some Cantonese for me?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, just a little, just a tiny bit...
Only the ones Crown-san uses often...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, even so, I'm plenty happy!
I love how earnest you are.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And speaking of which—
I was just about to head out for a run myself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: May I join you as well, Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, whew...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, what a great view!
...We've run pretty far, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yeah. Should we head back soon? To the academy...?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh, we're just heading straight back?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Uh... Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, hey, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Didn't I tell you before? That I'm really looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Won't you tell me?
...In your own words.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
J-Just... a little bit.
...Will you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what a beautiful beach.
You sure know some nice spots, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, it was a coincidence!
I just happened to find it while fishing—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Wait, n-no, that's not it!
...Um.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Won't you tell me?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I am—!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm, also...!
...I'm entering the "Japan Cup".

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...All of you, you were always... so far away.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"She can do anything and is super talented,
so she's had huge expectations on her since before her debut."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Some proudly carry their family's prestige.
Some have had their eyes set on the world from an early age.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Even if they're left behind at first, staying positive and trying hard, working hard... until everyone starts cheering them on.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is... so different from me.
I can't be like my older sister, nor like my younger sister—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I was trapped in the darkness forever.
I thought... you and I were completely different."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: B-But...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Still, you always...
You'd always call someone like me your "rival."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Miss Crown is... always like that.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san, and Kita-san too.
I will acknowledge them head-on and accept them for who they are.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
They push each other, and on top of that—they smile.
And on top of that, each believing the summit is rightfully theirs.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. I'm envious.
It's so cool.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I even think it's "magnificent."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—That's why!!
That is why, I...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Crown, I want to beat you!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Running so skillfully, being so amazing!
Always the center of attention, making me so envious!
And yet, being so cool that you even acknowledge someone like me!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
To you, who are greater than anyone in this era!
To Satono Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I want to win! ...I want to win!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I'll definitely win, and become who I've
always, always wanted to be――"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I will! Become a "great Umamusume"...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(—Cheval's words, echoing with enough fiery passion
to blow away even the morning mist, were—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (So pleasantly, so sweetly. It swayed my ears—and my heart.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, just so we're clear.
Don't get the wrong idea, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...? A-A misunderstanding...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I have never once called you my rival
out of pity or kindness, you know.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I just want to stand at the very top, in the truest sense.
And for that to happen, I want every girl running with me to give everything they've got."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I was just fully convinced, deep down...
that Cheval Grand would be the one
nipping at my heels.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...! Crown-san—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I am so happy.
...Yes, truly happy! 太好啦!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for getting fired up!
I can finally fight you at your best!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Even so—the one who wins will be me, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: She really is so cool—
And so came the day of the Japan Cup.

In the paddock, Umamusume gathered from all over the world,
and the renowned Japanese Umamusume ready to face them
assembled one after another—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to working with you!!
My revenge for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...
I will definitely claim it here and now!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The top festival girl in all of Japan is none other than me!!
(WOOOOOO!!)

Heat was already engulfing the venue.
Yet among it all, the one radiating the most
blinding flames of fighting spirit was—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I'm looking forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Today is... *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I will. ...I will win, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh, look who's talking!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Still, when it comes to preparing against you,
I don't intend to lose to anyone here, you know?
choice_data_list: Just as planned. Stay calm and steady, Crown!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
! Yes, just like always!
Leave it to me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Let us begin.
To seize the title at the summit—
Yes, a passionate sesssshhion!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Please let me, Sounds of Earth,
join your concert too!!
Why, you ask? The reason is plain to see—...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"My surging heartbeat is purely appassionato...!
Naturally, there was no holding it back—...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now then, fair yet fierce lady singing at center stage.
Will you perhaps lend your ear to the serenade
I shall play upon the racetrack...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Huh, of course!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Cheval
text_block_list.text: Wh... What kind of crazy thing is heading this way!?

And so, the curtain rose on the battlefield
of a turbulent Japan Cup—!
